headline: Davis & Elkins alone still have a match to play
dek: Davis & Elkins have conceded ten goals in eighteen matches, fewer than any other side in the conference, and won their latest by a goal, as did Charleston, who have seventeen wins in twenty. Concord, the third side out on the same day, were beaten away from home.
displaced_by: Davis & Elkins have now conceded ten in eighteen, so the standing dek's nine in seventeen no longer holds; they are the only side with a match left.
